<string name="notification_access_required_message">CreoleCast does not read your notifications. Android only lets an app reach the active media session — where track info, artwork and the play/pause/skip controls live — if it is registered as a notification listener. That is the only reason this is needed.

It also isn't just for showing track info: some receivers (like the Music Assistant AriaCast Receiver) only start playback once CreoleCast tells them playback has started, and that signal comes from the same media session. Without it, casting can look connected and audio can be sent, but nothing will actually play.

If Android shows "This setting is currently unavailable" or "Restricted setting", go to Settings → Apps → CreoleCast, tap the ⋮ menu in the top right, and choose "Allow restricted settings" — this is required for apps installed outside the Play Store. Then try enabling it again.</string>
